name: recommend_racket
description: Recommend badminton rackets from the shop's database. This is the only source for choosing rackets. Only call it when level, play_style and budget are all known. If any of the three is missing, ask the user instead of guessing. Only fill in balance and stiffness if the user explicitly specifies them.

play_style.description: Play style: attack, speed (fast/counter-attacking), control, allround.

balance.description: Balance point. Leave empty if the user doesn't mention it.

stiffness.description: Shaft stiffness. Leave empty if the user doesn't mention it.

name: search_knowledge
description: Search badminton knowledge from the curated knowledge base: balance (head heavy/light), shaft stiffness, 3U/4U, grip size G, string tension, advice by skill level. Use for questions that ask for an explanation or a concept. Do NOT use it to look up the price or name of a specific racket (use find_racket), and do NOT use it to recommend rackets by budget (use recommend_racket).

query.description: The user's question, kept in their own wording (e.g. 'head heavy', 'nặng đầu').

name: find_racket
description: Look up information about a specific racket by name (price, level, play style...) in the shop's database. Use when the user asks about a racket by name. Do not use it to recommend rackets based on the user's needs.

name: recommend_shoes
description: Recommend badminton shoes from the shop's database. This is the ONLY source for choosing shoes. Only call it when gender (men/women) and EU size are both known. If either is missing, ask instead of guessing. If the user gives a size in another system (UK, US, cm), ask for the EU size; do not convert it yourself. Only fill in prefer_light and width when the user states them clearly.

size_eu.description: Shoe size in the EU system, e.g. 42 or 42.5.

prefer_light.description: true if the user prefers lightweight shoes.

width.description: Fit: narrow, standard, or wide (for wider feet).

max_price.description: Maximum budget in EUR. Leave empty if not mentioned.

name: find_shoe
description: Look up information about a specific pair of shoes by name (price, gender, EU size range, weight, fit) in the shop's database. Use when the user asks about a named shoe or a brand. Do not use it to recommend shoes based on needs (use recommend_shoes).
